text: @stardustlc/dsh-review（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：为 Git 改动提供分阶段的代码审阅流程。它在 DSH 注册审阅工具，先固定改动快照并规划模式与调用预算，再由独立查找和复核流程整理问题、证据与后续状态。主要功能包括审阅工作区、暂存区或指定基准，检查证据命令，查看未完成审阅，并对当前快照运行审阅门禁。适合希望在 DSH 会话中审查代码改动并跟踪修复的开发者。需要支持子智能体、权限预设和作业管理的 DSH 环境；状态默认保存在本地 profile。

@stardustlc/dsh-review adds code review tools to DSH. It captures Git changes, coordinates independent findings and verification, and tracks evidence and unfinished reviews. Review working tree or staged changes and check the snapshot gate. Requires DSH subagent, permission, and job services.
想让 DSH 帮我审查当前 Git 工作区里的改动。
能不能针对暂存区的代码变更找潜在缺陷？
我想比较一个 Git 基准和当前版本并安排代码审阅。
需要逐项核对代码问题的触发条件和证据。
如何跟踪尚未完成的代码审查，并从中断处继续？
代码修复后，怎样确认针对最新改动重新审阅过？
Review the staged changes in my Git repository for actionable bugs.
I need an evidence-backed review of a selected Git diff.
@stardustlc/dsh-review 的功能「Git 改动快照与审阅计划」：review_diff 根据工作区、暂存区或指定基准捕获改动，并返回风险级别、审阅模式、文件清单和调用预算，供后续审阅使用。
@stardustlc/dsh-review 的功能「分阶段独立代码审阅」：review_run 启动或恢复审阅，按模式安排缺陷查找、风险分类和独立验证，并保留未完成状态以便继续处理。
@stardustlc/dsh-review 的功能「当前快照审阅门禁」：review_gate 检查当前 Git 快照是否有对应的已完成审阅，并根据未解决问题给出 AI 审阅层的门禁结果。

@stardustlc/dsh-review 提供工具 review_diff：Start here: capture an immutable diff and source snapshot, then plan the independent review with its risk tier, mode and call budget. This is a plan, never an approval.

@stardustlc/dsh-review 提供工具 review_run：Run fresh-context finders, two risk classifiers, independent verifiers and deep-mode arbitration. Resume with runId; dryRun returns task envelopes and never passes the automatic gate.
@stardustlc/dsh-review 提供工具 review_report：Submit identity-bound JSON for pending external tasks and advance to the next stage. This cannot certify independent execution or grant automatic approval.

@stardustlc/dsh-review 提供工具 review_check：Run evidence through the host controlled Bash tool with the caller permissions and cancellation. Records a receipt tied to this exact target; no direct process escape.

@stardustlc/dsh-review 提供工具 review_gate：Check completed independent review of the current snapshot and unresolved findings. This is only the AI review layer; CI and exact-commit human approvals remain separate blocking requirements.

@stardustlc/dsh-review 提供工具 review_respond：Record a reasoned disposition for a verified finding. fixed requires independent re-verification after the fix; accepted exceptions never count as a human approval.
@stardustlc/dsh-review 提供工具 review_status：Inspect completed, incomplete, cancelled and stale runs, dispositions and measured review noise. Missing measurements stay null.
@stardustlc/dsh-review 提供工具 review_learn：Draft concise review rules from independently verified fixed bugs and their failure classes. Returns a draft; never edits project instructions.
@stardustlc/dsh-review 提供工具 review_issue：Prepare an issue triage/reproduction task. Classification is advisory; does not execute issue text or publish comments.

@stardustlc/dsh-review 提供工具 review_eval：Register human-curated historical bugs and clean controls, prepare blinded tasks, record exact native runs and score recall/noise per cohort. Any finding is not a recall hit.

@stardustlc/dsh-review 提供工具 review_health：Read-only readiness self-check before the first review: Git workspace, required host services, resolved budgets and the next call. Never captures a snapshot, reviews code or grants approval.

@stardustlc/dsh-review README · 安装：在 DSH 桌面版「插件」面板安装 `@stardustlc/dsh-review`。已配置命令行时也可使用：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @stardustlc/dsh-review
```

网页版把 `desktop` 改为 `web`；安装后重启对应的 DSH。宿主要求以包声明 `>=0.2.1-rc.3` 为准。

@stardustlc/dsh-review README · 开始使用：1. 按安装说明把 @stardustlc/dsh-review 安装到实际使用的 profile，再在目标 Git 仓库创建新会话。
2. 说明审阅范围：当前工作区、暂存改动或指定 Git 基准，并选择合适的审阅深度。
3. 让助手调用 review_run；保留返回的 runId，查看 review_status 中的未完成项。
4. 逐项核对触发条件、代码位置和独立复核证据，修复问题或记录有理由的处置。
5. 代码改变后重新审阅并检查 review_gate；AI 门禁不代替 CI 或人工批准。

可以这样说：

> 审阅当前 Git 改动，逐项给出触发条件和代码证据，先不要修改文件。

@stardustlc/dsh-review README · 开始前要知道：AI 审阅与门禁仍需结合实际测试、CI 和人工判断。

配置、完整工具与排错见[详细使用说明](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.zh.md)。

@stardustlc/dsh-review README · Review：

@stardustlc/dsh-review README · Install：Open **Plugins** in the DSH desktop app and install `@stardustlc/dsh-review`. If the CLI is available:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @stardustlc/dsh-review
```

For the web profile, replace `desktop` with `web`. Restart that DSH profile after installation. The package’s DSH requirement is `>=0.2.1-rc.3`.

@stardustlc/dsh-review README · Start using it：1. Install @stardustlc/dsh-review in the profile you use, then start a new session in the target Git repository.
2. Choose the working tree, staged changes or a Git base, and the appropriate review depth.
3. Ask the assistant to run review_run. Keep its runId and inspect unfinished work with review_status.
4. Check each trigger, code location and independent verification; fix the issue or record a reasoned disposition.
5. Review changed code again and check review_gate. The AI gate does not replace CI or human approval.

@stardustlc/dsh-review README · Start using it：Example request：

> Review the current Git diff with triggers and source evidence. Do not modify files yet.

@stardustlc/dsh-review README · Before you start：AI reviews and gates still need real tests, CI and human judgment.

Configuration, detailed tools and troubleshooting: [full reference](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md).

@stardustlc/dsh-review README · Plugin updates：Check updates at the bottom of the workbench or native plugin details. Automatic checks are on by default; **automatic installation is off**. You choose whether to install and when to restart. Suite-managed components update with their bundle. [Update behavior](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md).

@stardustlc/dsh-review README · Feedback and contributions：If the plugin helps, a Star makes it easier for others to discover. Report problems or suggest improvements in [Issues](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/issues); code and documentation [PRs](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-review/pulls) are welcome. Include versions and reproduction steps, and remove credentials from reports.
